rows.note: 1.1% of consideration on recording a deed; 1.45% in total with the additional 0.35% that applies except to residential sales under $400,000.

rows.note: Imposed on the transferor; 1.45% in total with the additional 0.35% that applies except to residential sales under $400,000.
